0022600101.text: The Grizzlies (1-0, 2nd in the Southwest, 3rd in the West) are coming off their first win of the season, while the Golden State Warriors open their 2026-27 season. The teams have not met yet this season, but Memphis lost all three meetings in 2025-26, including a 133-112 defeat in Memphis on February 25. Isaiah Stewart is day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision for Memphis, while Golden State is missing Brandin Podziemski (back soreness), Charles Bassey (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee, surgery).
